label: Controls for the LIVING_2-to-LIVING_1 route at the Dei Filius root
paraphrase: Closed controls on interpretations with two beings (Bool), one respect and one time: (1) the time-indexed premise STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES and the restricted sense bridge hold together and a pure act lives (LIVING_1); (2) sense-mixing control: STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES holds, the sense bridge fails, and a pure act lives at some time (LIVING_2) without living (LIVING_1); (3) the bridge holds while STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES fails and a pure act does not live; (4) the restricted bridge holds while the unrestricted LifeAtSomeTimeIsLiving fails; (5) the restricted bridge and STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES hold while 'Whatever HAS_INTELLECT_1 is LIVING_1' fails. Statements about these interpretations only.
